snippet.title: CODE-BLACK - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Official Announcement Trailer

WISHLIST CODE-BLACK NOW! ~ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702510/CodeBlack/

Coming Soon to Steam and Epic Games!

Code-Black is a Solo Developed next-gen Single-Player Zombie Survival FPS.

Zombies are a work-in-progress and hordes will become larger, faster, and stronger, and more importantly, more optimized as development progresses.

"During an unexpected event humanity was blindsided by mass outbreak. With the majority being taken by the infection, and the military left helpless. The ones living are hiding, or forced to scavenge, survive, and fight in this living graveyard."

~ Rugir J.z [ Jam Zeus ]

EXPLORATION
Ground Zero is a large world that contains many hidden areas and secrets ready to discover, including puzzles, weapons, enemies, abilities, perks, upgrades, power-ups, and much more

DISMEMBERMENT
Zombies are no fun unless you can chop their limbs off, am I right? ~ Dismemberment also has its own hidden secrets and features, all i can say is, head is good!

UPGRADE WEAPONS
Weapons all have the ability to be upgraded at various machines within the world; Including the "Weapon Armory," "Mystery Slots," the "Teslectrifier," and the "Crafting Bench"

AKIMBO, I THINK SO...
Nearly every equippable gun in the game can be also used in Akimbo; I'll just let you figure that one out as you go

UNIQUE MOVEMENT ABILITIES
Rugir J.z is capable of some interesting movement mechanics for you to get the upper-hand, or the "upper-draft" on the zombies, and sneak out of sticky situations if used correctly

HELPFUL PERKS
Rugir is somehow not dead from shooting up a wack-load of unknown substances, in fact, hes seemed to have gained some weird supernatural or superhuman like abilities

POWER UPS
Surviving and getting kills can grant you certain Power Ups allowing you to get a boost or a helping hand here and there

LEADERBOARDS
Compete on Global Leader-Boards with many different gameplay driven Stats, including but not limited to; Kills, Critical Kills, Rounds Survived, and my personal favourite, Teabags!

Join the CODE-BLACK Discord Server to keep up to date with development, release dates, early access giveaways and contests, etc. https://discord.gg/dSNh2fKMTz
